The cited record states those conditions only as agent_proposed (E7, E3). Read 'The stage asks' as 'the proposed stage would ask'. E7's source reversal for the review point is not explained in the cited words.
would_settle: A source-attributed element, not agent_proposed, stating the Right's training condition and a test or review point; or an author statement confirming them.
